g.text: Each point is one treatment or biological ATAC replicate; controls are not plotted. Quality was identical across three technical repeats.

g.text: Missing correlation is omitted, never replaced by zero. Baseline regions are a fixed comparison set, not truth. Genrich uses its recorded q-value operating point.
